title: 跨地点协作时，怎样约定团队见面和配合方式
topic: 读 Airbnb Live and Work Anywhere 原则，练习在灵活办公安排中协调团队聚会和日常配合。

source.title: Life at Airbnb
source.type: Airbnb 员工工作地点与团队协作原则

fullTextHeadings.2: Our Live and Work Anywhere policy has five principles:

paragraphs: Have the flexibility to work temporarily from anywhere in the world, with company approval and where regulations allow.
Meet up regularly for team gatherings to connect with one another.
Work in a highly coordinated way.
translations: 在获得公司批准且符合法规的情况下，员工可以灵活地暂时在世界其他地方工作。
定期参加团队聚会，彼此建立联系。
以高度协调的方式开展工作。
fullTextParagraphs: At Airbnb, you have the flexibility to live and work anywhere—while also experiencing in-person connection that makes our culture special.
Our Live and Work Anywhere policy has five principles:
Work from home or an office.
Live anywhere in the country you’re employed and compensation won’t change.
Have the flexibility to work temporarily from anywhere in the world, with company approval and where regulations allow.
Meet up regularly for team gatherings to connect with one another.
Work in a highly coordinated way.
verifiedFacts: Airbnb 的公开材料介绍了本课练习的工作做法。
练习场景为虚构训练，不代表公司真实员工对话。

notes.phrase: with company approval and where regulations allow
notes.meaning: 获得公司批准且符合法规
notes.explain: 异地工作需同时符合公司审批要求和所在地法规；不能只确认获得批准。
notes.example: I’ll confirm company approval and local requirements before working from another location.

notes.phrase: Meet up regularly for team gatherings
notes.explain: regularly 表示按稳定频率安排聚会；本课用每季度一次作为虚构建议。
notes.example: We’ll meet up regularly for a team gathering each quarter.

notes.phrase: Work in a highly coordinated way
notes.explain: 协调方式应具体到共享计划中的负责人、交接和下一步，而不只是说“协作得更好”。
notes.example: Please coordinate the teams’ work in the shared plan.

scenario.title: Airbnb工作场景练习（虚构）
english: A project team works from several cities. Some members will temporarily work from another location, while the team needs to plan an in-person gathering and keep weekly handoffs clear.
Write a message confirming that location changes need approval, propose a regular team gathering, and name the shared coordination method.
chinese: 项目团队分布在多个城市。有人计划暂时换地点办公，同时团队需要安排线下聚会并保持每周交接清楚。
写一条消息，确认地点变更需审批，提出定期团队聚会，并说明共享协作方式。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请给团队发消息：异地办公前先确认公司批准和当地要求；建议每季度安排一次团队聚会；日常任务统一更新到共享计划中。
firstAttempt.sample: Before working temporarily from another location, please confirm company approval and local requirements. I suggest we meet up once a quarter to stay connected. Let’s keep daily owners and handoffs updated in the shared plan so we can work in a highly coordinated way.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先给出关键背景和动作，再说明责任人与时间。

structure.original: Meet up regularly for team gatherings to connect with one another.
analysis: 用 meet up regularly 说明团队定期建立联系，再用 coordinate... in the shared plan 落实跨地点协作。
迁移时补上新的工作对象、负责人和明确期限。
structure.transfer: Let’s meet up every quarter for a planning day. Please confirm travel approval before booking, and keep owners and next steps updated in the shared project plan.

rewrite.bad: We should get together sometime. Work together better.
rewrite.good: Let’s plan one in-person team day each quarter. Please confirm travel approval before booking. We can use the shared calendar for availability and the project plan to coordinate owners and follow-ups.
rewrite.translation: 我们每季度安排一次线下团队日。预订前请先确认差旅批准。我们可以用共享日历收集空闲时间，并在项目计划中协调负责人和跟进事项。
rewrite.pattern: State the context, propose a clear action, and name the owner or deadline.
